notes: Version-controlled approved cross-type family registry. Consumed by scripts/cwk_entity_catalog.py during catalog build. Every entry carries a stable `entry_id` and a truthful decision record (`decided_by`, `decided_at`, optional `decision_ref`); catalog build verifies every listed evidence quote against the referenced raw report and fails closed on any mismatch. Provenance quotes must be verbatim from raw reports; the register is data, not code or ranking heuristics.
